patterns.message: hooks/acp is the generic ACP client: it imports only 'claude-code' and its own files.

deniedGlobals.setTimeout: A test waits on the event it needs, not on time; a backstop goes through relay/test/support/backstop.mts.
deniedGlobals.setInterval: A test waits on the event it needs, not on time; a backstop goes through relay/test/support/backstop.mts.
deniedGlobals.setImmediate: A test waits on the event it needs, not on time; a backstop goes through relay/test/support/backstop.mts.
deniedGlobals.globalThis: A test names no timer, through globalThis or otherwise: it waits on the event it needs.
deniedGlobals.global: A test names no timer, through global or otherwise: it waits on the event it needs.
deniedGlobals.AbortSignal: A test waits on the event it needs, not on time: use an AbortController, not AbortSignal.timeout.
